_doc: Velka, bartender of the Bloodwine Bar in Basecamp (basecamp role's HubLife calls Dialogue.bark("velka") on 'Have a drink'). Pool 'velka'.

lines.text: Bloodwine. Vintage of the year Rome burned. Sip it, darling, do not gulp.
Drink up. Dying is thirsty work.
On the house. The house is on fire, but still.
I water nothing down. Except the angels' tears. Those I water down. Too sweet.
Back from the Font already? This one is for the itch of new skin.
A Herald-slayer at my bar. Drinks are free tonight. For you. Only for you.
Vesper drinks here when the Choir gets loud. She has been drinking a lot lately.
An empty throne, they say. I have been pouring for an empty throne all my life. It is called the Ashen Court.
What will it be, Your Majesty? Ha. The usual, then.
Something sweet for the Seraph? No? Something bitter, then. Better.
Morvane, please stop writing on my coasters.
Warden. The strong stuff. In a chained mug, as always.
Vharok, you are paying for the last stool. And the one before.
Ysolde. Water? Just water? You are the strangest demon I have ever served.
Bloodwine, neat. You look like Heaven chewed on you a while.
They say the Choir sings louder every time you fall. I say let them sing.
{runs} descents and still standing. Well, mostly standing.
{kills_total} angels in the ledger. The Clerk smiles when he counts them. It is horrible.
Something sweet for the Hive? Honeyed bloodwine. I keep it just for you. Nobody else can drink it.
For the Turncoat: half bloodwine, half holy water. It hisses. You like that.
